english.html: to the Papal dignity, which she held two years, one month and four days: and would have held it longer, had she not too immodestly abandoned herself to a servant; by whose doings being pregnant, as she was going one day to St John Lateran, pressed by the pains, she gave birth in the middle of the street, between the Colosseum and St Clement's. Whence since then the Roman Pontiff, in horror and detestation of so monstrous and abominable a deed, when he goes to the said Saint John's, turns aside from this street so as not to pass through it. And moreover, so as not to fall into a like error, as soon as the pope is created, he is placed on the seat of St Peter (pierced for that purpose), where the youngest of the Cardinal Deacons handles his genitories from beneath, and afterwards cries aloud, The Pope has testicles (Papa testiculos habet) z. These are the principal histories of the substitution of persons that I have been able to gather: by which, nevertheless, nor by our laws either, we cannot well determine a certain penalty for this deed. Whether it be by the law of Antoninus a, which wills that the crime of Forgery (of which nevertheless the ordinary penalty is only banishment and confiscation — which is by Justinian taken away, and the goods preserved to the heirs c) when there is substitution of persons be punished capitally d: and although the interpretation of this word, Capitally, which may be referred to civil and to natural death e, must be committed to the discretion of the Judge; who, weighing all the circumstances, will consider whether the deed deserves that the accused be put to death, either naturally or civilly f: nevertheless in the case of our Arnauld du Tilh there are so many capital crimes assembled, each worthy of the last punishment, that there is no great reason to doubt further about it: as by what we shall say hereafter will appear more clearly.
